First public release.

MyDeck turns an Android tablet into a touch control panel for your Windows PC. Tiles can open apps, send shortcuts, run macros, change the volume of a single app, control media and show live sensor data. Everything stays on your local network.

## Install

1. Download `MyDeck-win-x64.zip` below and unzip it anywhere.
2. Run `MyDeck.exe`. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. On the tablet, open the address shown in the MyDeck window and install the app.
4. Open MyDeck on the tablet and accept the connection on the PC if the codes match.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and Android 5.1 or newer. Nothing else to install.

## What's in it

- Editor with drag and drop, pages, folders and a live preview
- Virtual deck window, so the same deck works on the PC too
- Buttons, sliders, media tiles, sensor graphs, clocks, timers, calendar and weather
- Pages that switch on their own when a given program comes to the front
- Plugins (`.mydeckplugin`), with two examples attached below
- Tablets on the network are found automatically
- Automatic updates for the PC app and the tablet app
- English and Turkish

`MyDeck-win-x64.zip.sha256` holds the SHA-256 checksum of the zip.
